title: Special Encounters
overview: It's game over for one hobby and game on for a new one. High schooler Minami puts down a video game and picks up golf!

title: Special Friend
overview: Haruka provides Minami some guidance. Minami’s first shot ever on a golf course is one to remember.

title: Special Job
overview: Haruka gives Minami her old golf set. Minami is excited to have the "ultimate equipment" but realizes the driving range costs a lot of money. She gets a part-time job.

title: Special Club
overview: Minami steps into her very first golf shop. She bursts with excitement at the cute golf covers and golf wear. What really catches her attention is the "utility" golf club.

title: Special Training
overview: Minami is full of excitement; however, she isn't feeling any rapid progress. Meanwhile, her midterm exams lay ahead.

title: Special Round
overview: Minami is in for a lot of firsts! She heads towards her very first round at her very first golf course and she hits her first shot with the utility.

title: Special Finishing Move!
overview: Minami borrows a light novel from her classmate, Izumi. She unintentionally gains a hint on how to level up her golf game.

title: Special Caddie
overview: Ayaka suggests they use prize money to play golf on a gorgeous course. Meanwhile, there appears to be something going on between Haruka and Megumi.

title: Special Buzz
overview: Minami realizes she and Haruka have not seen Ayaka for some time now. Ayaka stopped posting on her social media. What's going on?

title: Special Milady!?
overview: On a rainy day Minami and Ayaka start practicing simulation golf. However, a small challenge barges into their game.

title: Special Doubles Match
overview: The foursome is split up into teams consisting of Minami with Hina, and Haruka with Ayaka, to play a round using doubles rules.

title: Special 'Special'
overview: A divine message, or just a dream? There's only one way to find out, and Minami knows where to look for answers... but is she brave enough to go solo for the first time?
